title: 第7章 淘宝第8章 宝物到手
content_zh:
萧天走向叶净心，开口道，“我两年前就可以修炼了，但是当时种种原因，不想让人知道，现在过去那么久了才公开的。”
叶净心点点头，又摇摇头，身体向后退了一步。
脸上尽是担忧。
萧天当然明白，主要是叶净心担心她自己配不上自己。
萧天安慰道“你不用担心，我既然决定要娶你，就肯定不会反悔，而且你想呀，如果我是你想的那种人上次我就不会主动找你了，所以你就不用想太多了。”
萧天趁机抓住叶净心的手，入手柔润温和，十分的舒服。
叶净心也被萧天的举动吓了一跳。
弄得她满脸通红，小心脏砰砰直跳。
叶净心羞涩的点点头，看得旁边的婢女直偷笑。
萧天接着道“再说，净心你的情况又不会是一直这样，我坚信你也可以修炼的。”
听到这话，叶净心的眼中泛起希望的神光，随后又慢慢退去。
她在经历了一次次的希望到失望的过程，现在已经不再奢望了。
看着叶净心这个神情，萧天也是深有体会。
所以只能握紧一下她的小手安慰。
当然更期待到时治愈叶净心后的表现。
萧天没有解释，毕竟能治愈叶净心这种情况的人太少，方法也太奇特，所以说了反而给两人带来尴尬和莫大的危险外没有其他好处。
“就当成婚后给她的第一个礼物吧，相信能给她惊喜。
嘿嘿嘿…”
萧天如此想道。
调整一下思绪，萧天笑着对叶净心说道：“我们出去逛逛街吧。”

叶净心也是调整过来，开心的点点头。
然后被萧天拉着手向大门外走去。
一路上，叶府里的人看到萧天拉着叶净心这一幕，都在小声议论。
弄得叶净心满脸通红，还好，叶净心已经有装扮成和萧天第一次见面那时的装束。
外人就看不到真切了。
一路上叶净心紧紧的抓住萧天的手，直到出了大门才稍微松开一些，可见其紧张程度。
出来后，两人走在繁华街道上，两边商品琳琅满目，有丹药铺，有兵器铺，有卖符纸的，也有卖平凡人所用的一些店铺。
所谓应有尽有。
不过店铺里面的东西都相对比较贵一些，当然质量也更有保证，毕竟店就在这里，不好的话估计很快就会关门大吉的。
但是走贩可就不一定了，买到的东西好坏全凭手气，东西过手就不可退，这些都是大家交易中默认的规矩。
因为这些原因，城里还专门有一条街道叫淘宝街，就是让这些个商贩摆摊的，这样也可以让喜欢在地摊里淘宝的人选购更方便。
看到这些店铺摊档，萧天也是突然想到淘宝街，然后对着叶净心说道“我们去淘宝街看看吧。”
content_en:
Xiao Tian walked towards Ye Jingxin and said, "I was able to practice two years ago, but for various reasons at the time, I didn't want people to know, and now it's been so long since I made it public."
Ye Jingxin nodded, shook his head, and took a step back.
His face was full of worry.
Of course Xiao Tian understood that Ye Jingxin was mainly worried that she was not worthy of him.
Xiao Tian comforted him, "Don't worry. Since I decided to marry you, I will definitely not go back on my word. And think about it, if I were the kind of person you wanted, I wouldn't have taken the initiative to find you last time, so you don't have to think too much."
Xiao Tian took the opportunity to grab Ye Jingxin's hand, which was soft and gentle, and very comfortable.
Ye Jingxin was also shocked by Xiao Tian's actions.
Her face was red and her heart was beating fast.
Ye Jingxin nodded shyly, making the maid next to her snicker.
Xiao Tian continued, "Besides, Jing Xin, your situation will not always be like this. I firmly believe that you can also practice."
Hearing this, Ye Jingxin's eyes glowed with hope, and then slowly receded.
She has gone through the process of hope and disappointment again and again, and now she no longer has extravagant hopes.
Seeing Ye Jingxin's expression, Xiao Tian also understood it deeply.
So I could only hold her little hand to comfort her.
Of course, I am looking forward to Ye Jingxin’s performance after he is cured.
Xiao Tian did not explain. After all, there were too few people who could cure Ye Jingxin's condition and the method was too strange. Therefore, it would bring embarrassment and great danger to the two of them without any other benefit.
"Just think of it as the first gift you give her after marriage, I believe it will surprise her.
Hey hey hey..."
Xiao Tian thought so.
After adjusting his thoughts, Xiao Tian smiled and said to Ye Jingxin: "Let's go shopping."
Ye Jingxin also adjusted and nodded happily.
Then Xiao Tian took his hand and walked out of the gate.
Along the way, people in Ye Mansion were whispering when they saw Xiao Tian pulling Ye Jingxin.
It made Ye Jingxin's face flush. Fortunately, Ye Jingxin had already dressed up in the same outfit as when she first met Xiao Tian.
Outsiders can't really see it.
Ye Jingxin held Xiao Tian's hand tightly along the way, and didn't let go slightly until he left the gate, which showed how nervous he was.
After coming out, the two of them walked on the bustling streets. There were a dazzling array of products on both sides. There were elixir shops, weapon shops, some selling talismans, and some shops selling items used by ordinary people.
So-called everything.
However, the items in the store are relatively more expensive, and of course the quality is more guaranteed. After all, the store is here, and if it doesn't go well, it will probably close down soon.
But that's not necessarily the case with vendors. The quality of the items you buy depends entirely on luck, and items cannot be returned if they are passed over. These are the default rules in everyone's transactions.
For these reasons, there is a special street in the city called Taobao Street, where these vendors set up stalls, making shopping more convenient for those who like to shop for treasures at street stalls.
Seeing these shops and stalls, Xiao Tian suddenly thought of Taobao Street, and then said to Ye Jingxin, "Let's go to Taobao Street and have a look."
